text:
jade: noticed a spike in plugin_bind_error right after today's runtime unpin in eu-central (canary). opening thread to coordinate a rollback if needed.

deploybot: [automated] action=unpin_runtime runtime=v2.8.0 scope=eu-central user=jade run_id=rb-5240 started=1856788800

omar: digging in logs. ~0.5% of requests hitting plugin_bind_error, concentrated on longseq and tool-call flows. p95 elevated on canary nodes.

ops-aria: options: canary pin back to v2.7.6 (fast) or flip compat flag if present. prefer pin to limit blast radius.

lucy: support note ready. estimated customer impact <0.2%, but some automated workflows could see failures.

ops-aria: applying scoped override:
```
runtime_pins:
  eu-central:
    cohort: canary
    runtime: v2.7.6
```

ops-aria: /deploybot pin runtime v2.7.6 --scope=eu-central --cohort=canary --reason "plugin_bind_error after unpin"

deploybot: [automated] action=pin_runtime runtime=v2.7.6 scope=eu-central cohort=canary user=ops-aria run_id=rb-5240 status=completed ts=1856789055

omar: metrics post-pin: plugin_bind_error dropped to 0.02%, p95 back to normal.

jade: leaving safehold on further unpins until we add a handshake check to preflight and get an SDK confirmation. assigning follow-ups: @omar add preflight check (INC-5240-1), @lucy draft customer comms (INC-5240-2).

ops-aria: /deploybot summary run_id=rb-5240 actions=unpin(v2.8.0,eu-central)->pin(v2.7.6,eu-central canary) status=rolled-back duration=255s

jade: thanks team — closing until follow-ups complete.
